The PSNR in dB against the sharp image. Both images are 160 by 160 pixels, blurred with the Gaussian PSF of sigma 2 and the reflect border, with Gaussian noise of sigma 5 from NumPy's default_rng with seed 7. The blurred images have 24.81 and 15.85 dB. The denoiser rows use lambda 10, rho 0.1, gamma 1 and 20 iterations. The last row is total variation restoration with its defaults, for comparison. Non-local means gives the best result and takes by far the longest.
